sun.management

类 Agent

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.management.Agent

  • public class Agent
extends Object
    This Agent is started by the VM when -Dcom.sun.management.snmp or -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote is set. This class will be loaded by the system class loader. Also jmx framework could be started by jcmd
